means: On danbooru this is a CROP tag: head and shoulders, tightly framed, like a passport photo. It is not a lens and not a page orientation.
does: Pulls the camera to the face. The evidence is accidental but clean: shot.lens.look's portrait option was authored as a LENS ("portrait lens, 85mm, mild compression") and the panel came back as a tight head-and-shoulders close-up - the model read the crop word and ignored the millimetres entirely. The word is overloaded three ways in this project (crop tag, "portrait lens", portrait aspect in make_sheets.py) and only the crop meaning ever reaches the picture.
reach_for_it: rarely - close-up says the same thing and is the better-represented tag. Use portrait when you specifically want the still, posed, straight-at-camera register rather than a dramatic close-up.
used_in: the portrait option of shot.lens.look, where the project's own review notes that millimetre numbers are inert tokens in Animagine
